facts.fact: Congo's regulator says it signed a free-roaming MoU with Gabon in October 2019 and joined the collegial signature of CEMAC bilateral MoUs in November 2021.
The Congo regulator reports free roaming with Gabon in effect, with call volumes shown before and after its start.
The Congo regulator publishes Congo-Gabon roaming call counts from January 2020 to December 2024, for example 81,563 in December 2024.
